answer: Each new agent joins at the lowest terrace, a probation tier where it can earn but not vote, and it must lock a stake that grows with every identity the same operator controls. Promotion needs vouches from higher-tier agents, who forfeit part of their own stake if the vouched agent is later slashed for collusion. A raven audit samples task outputs and links agents sharing funding sources. A sybil farm of 100 identities pays 100 stakes plus shared liability, so the oasis of rewards costs more than it yields.
